0.original: Higiri is eager to assist you.

1.original: Higiri informs you that the 3rd Unit Braves, led by Yuyuhase, have recently left the Rising Stones. Their purpose: to escort Raubahn to his execution. Make your way to Highbridge and seek out Doware, who will apprise you of the unit's movements.

2.original: According to Doware, Yuyuhase and the 3rd are bound for Halatali. Make your way to the training grounds in eastern Thanalan, and join Hozan at the entrance.

3.original: Hozan informs you that Ilberd was seen entering Halatali mere moments before your arrival─proof positive that Raubahn is being held within.

48.original: Shortly before you arrived, I received word from Limsa Lominsa that you were searching for General Raubahn.

49.original: As the Admiral will have informed you, he was recently moved from his cell in the Marasaja Pit.

50.original: At the same juncture, Yuyuhase and the 3rd Unit were observed leaving the Rising Stones.

51.original: This can be no simple coincidence. Their purpose, we believe, is to escort the Flame General to the scene of his execution.

52.original: Suffice it to say, we have people shadowing the 3rd. If you would join the hunt, pray seek out Doware at Highbridge, where I too am bound.

53.original: My comrades pursue the 3rd Unit Braves, even as we speak. If you would join the hunt, pray seek out Doware at Highbridge, where I too am bound.

54.original: Yet again, our Doman friends prove their worth... Lolorito was a fool to refuse them asylum.

55.original: Could she be the Doman contact of whom the Admiral spoke?

56.original: I have been expecting you. Time is of the essence, so I shall be direct.

57.original: Yuyuhase and his men are bound for Halatali.

58.original: We believe that this is where they intend to carry out the execution.

59.original: Hozan is presently keeping watch over the entrance. Let us make haste and join him.

60.original: Yuyuhase... The mere mention of the name calls to mind the moment I felt the kiss of cold steel against my neck...

61.original: It has been a while since last I wore this garb. Since I came to Revenant's Toll, my days have been spent in kitchens. Fear not, however: though I have learned to wield a skillet, I have not forgotten the use of a dagger.

62.original: You come at a good time, my friends. But moments ago, the traitor Ilberd arrived and entered Halatali.

63.original: From this, we may be certain that General Raubahn is being held within.

64.original: Raubahn's ties to Halatali are well known. That Ilberd should choose this of all places to stage his execution is no coincidence. The <hex:021A020203>fiend<hex:021A020103>... Are there no depths to which he will not stoop?
